# tarpeg007 — Saad Fellahi, offensive security

> Saad Fellahi (tarpeg007) is a penetration tester and offensive security researcher: 6 CVE credits in JavaScript frameworks, a CVSS 9.1 critical accepted on HackerOne, HTB CPTS & CBBH certified, based in Casablanca-Settat, Morocco. The site covers web/API penetration testing, bug bounty hunting, source code review, and pre-launch security testing.

## Pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://tarpeg007.github.io/): CVE record, bounty log, offensive-testing arsenal, experience.
- [Security writing index](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/): in-depth security-testing guides.
- [Which offensive security consulting fits startups best?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/offensive-security-consulting-startups/): Choose startup offensive security consulting with a scope matrix for web, API, cloud, AppSec, red-team, and continuous testing, plus provider-buying criteria.
- [Best Web App Penetration Testing Providers Compared](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/web-app-pentesting-providers-compared/): Compare web app penetration testing providers by methodology, API and access-control depth, reporting, retesting, and fit—so your team can buy confidently.
- [Which bug bounty providers fit your appsec scope?](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/bug-bounty-providers-appsec-scope/): Choose a bug bounty or application security testing provider by matching scope, tester access, triage, SLAs and retesting to the risk your application faces.
- [How to Use Security Test Resources Before Web Launch](https://tarpeg007.github.io/blog/security-testing-before-web-launch/): A practical pre-launch web app security testing playbook that maps OWASP WSTG scenarios to ASVS controls, exposes real risk, and produces retestable evidence.
